svg.title: Two graphs of intensity against angle, one above the other, drawn to the same horizontal scale. Top, 2 slits: broad maxima, equally spaced, labelled n equals minus 2 to plus 2, with intensity varying smoothly between them. Bottom, 10 slits with the same slit separation: the principal maxima are at exactly the same angles but are very narrow and sharp, with almost zero intensity between them apart from tiny bumps. Each graph is scaled to the same peak height.
svg.text: angle θ (same slit separation d in both)
